PHASE.NAME: UPGRADE_2 A3 And A8 Resume And Handoff
PHASE.GOAL: Add resumable agent context and structured multi-agent handoff artifacts for long-running bounded work.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Persisted run, action queue, belief state, and latest handoff flow into a compact AgentContext for resume.
Role completion creates ordered JSON handoff artifacts consumed by the next agent role.

STEPS.step-1: Create handoff model, role sequencing, storage paths, create/load/latest APIs.
STEPS.step-2: Create AgentContext builder, latest incomplete run lookup, and handoff-aware next action suggestion.
STEPS.step-3: Add syn agent resume/status text and JSON output.
STEPS.step-4: Create verifier-to-fixer handoff when self-heal diagnoses unresolved failures.

RISKS.RISK: Resume output must be compact enough for agents while still preserving evidence and next-action clarity.
Handoff artifacts must avoid becoming free-form prose that cannot be consumed by later tools.
